title: Topic 1.2: Listening for information, Interactive Speaking

pages.lesson:
LESSON: LISTENING FOR INFORMATION, INTERACTIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and speaking
Topic 1.2: Listening for information, Interactive Speaking

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Listening for information, Interactive Speaking. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we ensure we get all the needed information from a listening text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. listen to texts for information
2. value the role of listening texts in language acquisition

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: LISTENING FOR INFORMATION, INTERACTIVE SPEAKING
This lesson teaches Listening for information, Interactive Speaking for Grade 7 GERMAN.

STUDY STEPS
1. listen to texts for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. value the role of listening texts in language acquisition
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Listening for information, Interactive Speaking using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Listening for information, Interactive Speaking above.
2. Explain Listening for information, Interactive Speaking to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Listening for information, Interactive Speaking with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Listening for information, Interactive Speaking important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we ensure we get all the needed information from a listening text?
2. How do we make our conversations interactive?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. listen to texts for information
2. value the role of listening texts in language acquisition

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
